KP Sanghvi group companies have adopted RJC policies and procedures that document our commitment to responsible business practices, including policies on sourcing and human rights. All policies and corresponding due diligence are available on request; e-mail requests can be sent to legal@kpsanghvi.com. Any grievances related to the sourcing policies of the group are received and resolved by top management and can be addressed to legal@kpsanghvi.com. The group companies are classified as a small business as per OECD guidelines; annual supply-chain due-diligence systems and practices are available as a memorandum on request.
